Proposed Highway Characteristics

Design Elements
The proposed facility will be a freeway and will be designed in accordance with criteria set forth by the State of Wisconsin's Department of Transportation, Division of Highways, "ilwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission, the American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials, and as approved by the Federal Highway Administration.
The freeway type facility will be a divided highway with full control of access along its entire route. Access to this proposed freeway will be provided through interchange locations at existing I-94, at the air terminal facilities located directly west of General Mitchell Field, the new air cargo facility and existing Howell Avenue.
The freeway will be in embankment section and adequate drainage facilities will be provided.
All local through streets crossing the route of the proposed freeway facility will be grade spearated to minimize interruption to present traffic patterns. Proposed interchange and bridge locations are as shown on figure 16. Minimum vertical clearance for bridge grade separations will be 16'6" over I-94, 15'0" over local streets and 23'0" over the railroad tracks.
A typical four lane freeway section proposed for the Airport Spur is shown in figure 8. A 26 foot paved median with concrete barrier safety sections will be provided in the center. The outside and median shoulder widths are 10 feet and 6 feet, respectively.
